before: Script offsets and bar strokes took the size of the runs inside the structure.
after: Script offsets and bar strokes take the m:ctrlPr size of the structure, or the size of the text around the equation; a tall subscript drops until its ink top meets the subscript top limit. The surrounding text size travels as data on the equation piece, so bidi paragraphs keep it.
reason: The projection gains a read-only size read from preserved source, and only local equation geometry changes. Canonical OMML, offsets, operations, and collaboration data remain unchanged.
